The '''''Krayt's Honor''''' was a [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti Cruiser]] captained by [[Siqo Vass/Legends|Siqo Vass]], who, along with his crew, utilized his [[Cruiser/Legends|ship]] as an escort for independent [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. The merchants, who found themselves constantly harassed by criminals in the employ of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], were grateful to Vass and his crew for their services, but the Federation itself eventually came to target the ''Krayt's Honor'' specifically. Fortunately for Vass, he and his crew found themselves in favor with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who offered them haven on the arid [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. From there, the ''Krayt's Honor'' continued to prove an irritant to the Trade Federation.

==Description==
Constructed by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]], the 41.8-meter-long [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti Cruiser]] ''Krayt's Honor'' was armed with eight side-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser]] turrets for defense, in addition to several [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad cannon]] turrets that protected the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] dorsal and ventral hulls.<ref name="db" /> Apart from the standard armament, the ship boasted a variety of modifications: located in the ship's bow were a trio of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, in addition to a pair of fire-linked [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers, which carried an expanded payload.<ref name="db" /><ref name="sotg" />

The ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Siqo Vass/Legends|Siqo Vass]], would utilize the [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] as an opening salvo in an engagement, but would not reveal the ship's highly illegal turbolasers unless he had to. When used, however, the turbolasers could cause considerable damage to [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. For defense, the ''Krayt's Honor'' boasted military-grade [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] that were able to hold off [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attacks, but not those of capital ships.<ref name="sotg" />

==History==
The ''Krayt's Honor'' was captained by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Siqo Vass, although, to escape the widespread [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] prejudices of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Layn Wynest]] posed as captain.<ref name="sotg" /> The ship was crewed by a wide variety of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings from various [[Species/Legends|races]], including [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] and [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]]. The ''Krayt's Honor'' served as an escort for independent merchants who found themselves targeted by [[Pirate/Legends|raiders]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] acting covertly under the influence of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="db" /> a conglomerate that did not take kindly to competition.<ref name="sf">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> In order to do so, the ''Krayt's Honor'' worked as a [[Q-Ship]]&mdash;by appearing to be a common cargo craft, Vass could lure assailants in close enough to destroy them with the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] hidden weaponry.<ref name="sotg" /> The merchants themselves highly valued the actions of Vass and his crew, but the ''Krayt's Honor'' soon drew the Federation's ire and attention.<ref name="db" /> To make matters more difficult for the crew, the Federation placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vass.<ref name="sotg" />

Fortunately for Vass, one of the ships the ''Krayt's Honor'' saved was the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]&mdash;the personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="sotg" /> who was grateful enough to offer the crew and their ship haven on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], one of the rare ports that the Federation wanted nothing to do with.<ref name="db" /> In both [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref><ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the crew took the ship to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="nec" /><ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> As they made their home on Tatooine, Vass and his crew continued to harass the Federation, even during the pan-galactic [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="db" /> Eventually, they were brought into direct conflict with Federation craft, as opposed to the hired guns they had fought in the past.<ref name="sotg" /> Following the Clone Wars, the ship and its crew disappeared, its fate unknown.<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Krayt's Honor'' first appeared in [[1999]]'s {{Film|I}}, as an unidentified background ship in the film's Mos Espa sequence.<ref name="tpm" /> The ship was identified and given a backstory by "[[KenobiDX67]]" through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="db" /> published within the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[January 12]], [[2007]].<ref name="jan12">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20070112.html|text=What's the Story: Episode I}}</ref>
